item.title: Aquarius and Pisces compatibility: love, friendship and work
item.description: Aquarius and Pisces are both dreamers, and imagination runs high when these two meet. Aquarius thinks things through and Pisces feels things through, and each can miss the other's point. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Capricorn and Aquarius compatibility: love, friendship and work
item.description: Capricorn and Aquarius both think long term, and there is respect in how these two plan. Capricorn trusts tradition and Aquarius trusts change, and each can dig in. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Sagittarius and Capricorn compatibility: love, friendship and work
item.description: Sagittarius and Capricorn balance each other: vision on one side, method on the other. Sagittarius can find Capricorn cautious, and Capricorn can find Sagittarius careless. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Scorpio and Sagittarius compatibility: love, friendship and work
item.description: Scorpio and Sagittarius are both searchers after the truth, and conversations go deep and far. Scorpio wants closeness and Sagittarius wants room, and each can feel misread. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Libra and Scorpio compatibility: love, friendship and work
item.description: Libra and Scorpio are drawn to each other's charm and depth, and conversation has an edge. Libra wants harmony and Scorpio wants the whole truth, and each can find the other hard to read. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Virgo and Libra compatibility: love, friendship and work
item.description: Virgo and Libra share good taste and good manners, and conversations are thoughtful. Both can avoid saying the uncomfortable thing. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Leo and Virgo compatibility: love, friendship and work
item.description: Leo and Virgo make a strong team: Leo brings the vision and Virgo brings the detail. Virgo's care can sound like criticism to Leo, and Leo's flair can look careless to Virgo. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Cancer and Leo compatibility: love, friendship and work
item.description: Cancer and Leo are both warm-hearted: Leo brings the sunshine and Cancer brings the home. Leo needs praise and Cancer needs reassurance, and both can wait for the other to give first. Read more at astralroots.app
